Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Pooja Khan. I am a 41-year-old retired bank officer living in Nagpur. Das Traders gave me a cheque for ₹12,00,000 to repay a loan, but the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 71729 68809 or email pooja.khan@example.in.
